title: 数据科学与机器学习项目集
summary: 该项目包含作者在Nodebook数据科学与机器学习项目中完成的实际项目，涉及Python、机器学习、深度学习、大语言模型、生成式AI和AI代理，重点在于构建能思考、规划和行动的智能系统。
summary_en: A collection of real-world projects from the Nodebook Data Science & Machine Learning program, covering Python, ML, DL, LLMs, Generative AI, and AI Agents, with hands-on experience in building smart systems that think, plan, and act.
